email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoGluca patient with a tummy ache

[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a nurse practitioner at Fictional Community Clinic (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 64-year-old male patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their second dose of DemoGluca (dose: 10mg) via oral.
Treatment started on 2026-03-03.
Approximately 5 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed a tummy ache.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
R. Duval (fictional reporter)
Fictional Community Clinic
